profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Chainguard
profile.geoLocationName: South San Francisco, California, United States
profile.summary:
Senior full-stack software engineer with 20+ years building backend services, distributed systems, and full-stack applications — from fast-moving startups to large-scale government identity and biometric platforms across the Americas.
I'm a polyglot programmer, fluent in Go, Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Java, with an affinity for picking up new languages and platforms quickly. My focus is designing microservices, Kubernetes-native systems, and APIs that hold up under real-world load, backed by solid relational and NoSQL data design.
Recent work spans backend API services for an AI dental-practice assistant (Viva.ai), Kubernetes controllers for service mesh and API management (Solo.io), and event-driven microservices on AWS (Belong Gaming). Earlier in my career I built government ID, passport, and electoral systems integrating biometrics, cameras, and cryptography.
I like problems that reach beyond the screen — I'm a software-defined radio (SDR) hobbyist and tinker with embedded electronics (ESP32/ESP8266) and home automation in my spare time.
Native Spanish speaker, fluent in English.
Languages & tools: Go · Python · C# · JavaScript · TypeScript · Java · C/C++ · Kubernetes · AWS · Docker · PostgreSQL · MongoDB · DynamoDB · MS SQL Server
